column1: # P4-4-E2 (D4, 2026-11-13): the corpus for the Modbus/TCP content signature (modules/telemetry/experiments/engine-linux/modbus-sig.zeek):
# its false-positive rate on non-Modbus TCP traffic, and its detection on held-out Modbus/TCP moved off port 502.
# Public test traces from two publishers, each pinned by commit in its URL and by the file's SHA-256 (D4's own download on 2026-11-13).
# Not vendored: run.sh public fetches each file and checks it before use; a mismatch drops it, and its rows read "not run".
# Nothing here is from a site of the owner's. The traces are the publishers' own test captures, and where each one was recorded is not stated per file.
# The signature was written and committed (3436c8dc) before any file here was read.
# Licences, as each repository states them (D7 confirms):
#   zeek/zeek at v9.0.1 (commit d6ac56cdb31f3e643d88eb5c7421a31df7d3a520): COPYING, BSD-3-Clause, SHA-256 1f984adb6b5cd93d5035c2a87c2df5f38922649fbea90c7bd79ff321d17333aa,
#     the file D7 recorded in docs/release.md section 4. No trace carries terms of its own, so the repository's COPYING is the only stated term.
#   cisagov/icsnpp-* at the commits in the URLs: BSD-3-Clause and a NOTICE.txt carrying a US Government notice (DOE contract). SHA-256s:
# Labels, which flows are Modbus/TCP, by capture and by source, written before any run:
#   modbus=none    by its source, the capture holds no Modbus/TCP flow, so every TCP flow in it is a negative.
#   modbus=tcp/502 by its source, every TCP flow with an end on port 502 is Modbus/TCP, and no other flow is: zeek-modbus-big's two flows on port 102
#                  (ISO-TSAP) are negatives. run.sh moves port 502 to 15020 with D6's movedport.py and checks the result against moved_sha256;
#                  the unmoved capture runs beside it as its control on port 502.
# A flow is a pair of TCP ends, as flows.py reads them from the capture, never from an engine.
# No IEC 104 or MMS capture with stated terms was found: the public set's iec104, iec104-sq and mms (MANIFEST.tsv, Wireshark's samples, no stated terms)
# run under the signature's configuration in public.md, outside this corpus. zeek-mmsX holds one MMS request with no reply.
